# About new-line characters

New-line characters (CR or CR+LF) received from the host are converted to CR+LF pairs by Tera Term, and then Tera Term sends them to MACRO.
You should use the pair (CR+LF) as a new-line character to send to Tera Term.
ASCII code 13 (decimal) is for CR, and 10 is for LF.

Example:

<table>
  <tr>
    <td><code class="syntax">send 'abc'#13#10</code></td>
    <td>Same as the statement "<code>sendln 'abc'</code>". The actual new-line character to be sent to the host is determined by Tera Term.</td>
  </tr>

  <tr>
    <td><code class="syntax">wait #10'abc' 'def'#13</code></td>
    <td>Waits for a line beginning with "abc" or a line ending with "def".</td>
  </tr>

  <tr>
    <td><code class="syntax">logwrite 'abc'#13#10</code></td>
    <td>Writes line "abc" to the log file.</td>
  </tr>
</table>
